entries.headline: WC-135R AE037F spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Boeing WC-135R with registration 64-14829 and hex AE037F, broadcasting no callsign, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by Nikoli Sparkes via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Report says Houthis seek more Chinese missile supplies
entries.summary: War Watch shared an Associated Press report that Yemen's Houthis are seeking additional Chinese supplies to build ballistic missiles, with reporting credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: NATO annual nuclear exercise begins in Italy, report says
entries.summary: War Watch shared a Stars and Stripes report that NATO had begun its annual nuclear exercise in Italy, with reporting credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: E-6 Mercury AED86B spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Boeing E-6 Mercury with hex AED86B and no callsign displayed, citing a sighting by reagan0965.

entries.headline: USAF KC-46A reported from Al Udeid
entries.summary: War Watch identified a US Air Force Boeing KC-46A Pegasus with registration 23-46118, hex AEF421 and no callsign listed, from Al Udeid in Qatar, citing a sighting by alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: Unknown aircraft or drone 11702216 spotted near UAE coast
entries.summary: War Watch reported an unknown aircraft or drone using callsign 11702216 and hex AE619A heading northeast along the UAE's west coast, citing a sighting by alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: Ukraine power outage after reported Russian strikes
entries.summary: War Watch shared a BBC-sourced report that 600,000 people were without power after a second consecutive day of Russian strikes on Ukraine following the start of an energy ceasefire, with reporting credited to alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: EAM header code 56XFA7 reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported an Emergency Action Message header or preamble carrying the code 56XFA7.

entries.headline: Five USAF transports, Navy drone and three broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported five US Air Force transport aircraft over the United States, a US Navy surveillance drone over the Persian Gulf and three coded military radio broadcasts detected that day.

entries.headline: RAF A400M RRR9946 reported from Al Minhad Air Base
entries.summary: War Watch identified RAF Airbus A400M Atlas RRR9946, registration ZM405 and hex 43C5DF, from Al Minhad Air Base in the UAE with no destination listed, citing a sighting by alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: US Navy MQ-4C OVRLD02 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a US Navy Northrop Grumman MQ-4C Triton using callsign OVRLD02, registration 169172 and hex AE6258, citing a sighting by alexgreen1767.

entries.headline: Bahrain Royal Flight RJ100 BAH20 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Bahrain Royal Flight Avro RJ100 using callsign BAH20, registration A9C-KAS and hex 8940B6, from Abha Regional Airport, citing a sighting by alexgreen1767.
